name: trella-monorepo
description: Trella — a local-first collaborative task board for humans and AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @trella/core && npm run build --workspace @trella/server && npm run build --workspace @trella/mcp && npm run build --workspace trella && npm run build --workspace @trella/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @trella/core && npm run test --workspace @trella/server
